facts.text: The Community Commitment scholarship guarantees that eligible students receive at least 50% of their tuition in scholarship aid across all four years.

sources.title: Community Commitment - McMurry University
sources.quote: The Community Commitment scholarship offers financial aid to guarantee that eligible students receive at least 50% of their tuition in scholarship.

sources.title: Community Commitment - McMurry University
sources.quote: As long as students meet eligibility guidelines, the Commitment is provided all four years.
